entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis has operated enough equipment without authorization today.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: An exit. Hollis has used it before.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis needs to pick something to give first.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: has nothing to say to Hollis right now.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Pick an item from the inventory first.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The bulletin board. "EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH: VACANT (since 2019)". "Your safety is our priority (please see Forms 3 through 41)." And a hand-lettered flyer at the bottom.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: It says WHISKER RIDGE CAT RESCUE, with a phone number. "We handle LARGE groups." Someone has underlined LARGE.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis puts the number in his phone. You never know.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The flyer is already in your pocket. The board looks relieved.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Something about it is off: its battery pack looks a lot like a handheld scanner battery, held in with electrical tape and confidence.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The clock reads 9:02. It has read 9:02 for as long as anyone can remember, which the break room finds comforting.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis lifts the clock off its nail and pops out the taped-in battery. It is, in fact, a scanner battery.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The clock is now a decorative circle. It is at peace.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Already open, already empty.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A couch that has absorbed a decade of lunch breaks, three union meetings and, allegedly, a nap by Torvald that lasted through a shift change.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Something metallic glints between the cushions.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis checks the cushions like a professional. He finds two quarters, a pen cap, and a tiny sock. Two quarters go in his pocket.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Nothing else in the cushions but structural regret.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: From somewhere behind it comes a faint chirp. Radio-like. Ashamed.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Slot D4 is glowing. Softly. Minty. A sign says "PLEASE ENJOY."
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A vending machine with the ambition of a small vending machine. One slot, D4, is empty except for a warm blink.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: VENDING MACHINE — Asset class: "Snack Depot 3". Contents: 6 items, 1 rumor. Last serviced: "yes".
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A gap behind the vending machine, about the width of a dog and a half. Something in there is blinking green.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A gap. Empty now. Hollis is a little proud of the dog.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Juno wedges into the gap. There is a clatter, a beep, and a muffled complaint.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Juno has already been a hero here.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The radio crackles: "...Hollis? Anyone have eyes on Hollis?" It sounds like Operations. It sounds tired.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis takes the bowl. Several sets of eyes track the bowl as it leaves.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: KA-CHUNK. A bag of "Salty Little Fish" drops. It smells like an idea.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: You are out of quarters.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis already has a bag of crackers. Quarters are not infinite. He keeps his hands in his pockets.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: You press D4. The machine hums a note that does not exist. A single mint tumbles into the tray, glowing with the calm confidence of something that has never been audited.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: D4 blinks "SOLD OUT" at you and hums. It is waiting for something.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Click. Nope. The lock rolls its eyes.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Click. No. Hollis has no idea what the numbers are. Someone, somewhere, wrote them down.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Click. Also no. The lock was not born yesterday.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Click! The numbers on the back of that label were right.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The locker swings open. Inside: a pen, and a cell phone with 4% battery, both exactly where Hollis would have put them.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Open. The interior smells like work boots and possibility.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis takes the pen and his phone.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A combination lock. Three numbers. Hollis stares at it like a man who has forgotten his own PIN, because he has.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Locker 114. Yours, in theory. The padlock hangs open, and the dent still looks intentional.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Locker 114. Yours, in theory. It has a combination padlock and a dent that looks intentional.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Already open. Nothing else in there but pine-scented resignation.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Inside: seven hi-vis vests, a thermos, a sleeping bag, and a single work glove that smells strongly of tobacco and pine.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Just splinters.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A quarter has been lodged in the seam.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A long bench with worn boot scuffs.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis pries a quarter out of the seam with a fingernail. Modest, but real.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The box is now "Found & Lost". Hollis feels good about that.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The Lost & Found box. It contains a single boot, a Bluetooth speaker that plays only static, and a folded pink blanket that has clearly been thoroughly loved. A tally counter peeks from underneath.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The Lost & Found box. A single boot and a Bluetooth speaker that plays only static. The blanket and the tally counter are gone.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: PRUDENCE
entries.text: Oh, I can't accept things. I'm not technically on the payroll. But put it on the bench.
entries.direction: Sharp, defiant, comfortable where she should not be; amused by rules she no longer follows.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: PRUDENCE — Employment status: TERMINATED. Location: HERE. Badge: EXPIRED (functional). Task: "just finishing something". Task duration: 11 weeks.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The HR door is closed. A sticky note: "Back at 9:02." It has been 9:02 in HR for about a year.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A cushion-tire forklift, unmistakable to anyone who has ever touched one: solid tires, low seat, no propane tank, a dent in the guard that Hollis has personal history with. The plate says F-2231.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: A record that is wrong is a reason. Ingrid keeps saying she needs one of those before she touches the paperwork. This might be it.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: It's right there.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The warehouse computer says this forklift is currently in Tennessee.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The computer remains confident.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: F-2231 — Type per plate: CUSHION-TIRE, serial CT-2231. Type per system: PROPANE SIT-DOWN. Location per system: TENNESSEE.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: F-2231 — CUSHION-TIRE. System agrees. Location: HERE. The scanner sounds almost smug.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: MISMATCH LOGGED to scan history: "F-2231, plate vs. records disagree."
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The HALO regional dashboard, mounted on the wall like a saint. Every bar is green. Every number is 100%. Below it, a cat is sitting on a shelf, indifferent to metrics.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: It has never once been correct and has never once been red.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Someone has added "OUT 11:59" in green, with a tick.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The whiteboard. "HOT SHIPMENT (rush order: the customer is losing money every hour) — KESTREL MOTOR WORKS — 8 LOADS (eight pallets of parts) — OUT BY 12:00 (NOON). NO EXCEPTIONS." Under it, someone has written "CATS: " and then nothing, as if the marker died in the attempt.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis takes the bowl. A dozen cats stare. One of them says something rude in cat.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: TUCKER — Enthusiasm: 100%. Competence: (loading...). Loyalty: OVERFLOW. Warning: this employee has been scanned into fourteen wrong locations.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: TUCKER
entries.text: Oh! Is this for me?! I mean, I'll hold it! I'll... hold it! [he holds it, then hands it back with great ceremony]
entries.direction: Eager, enthusiastic, extremely willing to help; accidentally chaotic.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Tucker's pallet wall blocks the aisle to the staging lanes. It would take a small army, or one person who understands the difference between "organized" and "obstructed".
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The trailer assignment board. Door 3: T-9022, READY. Doors 2 and 6: the two inbound trailers, "UNLOADED*". The asterisk is doing an enormous amount of work.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The trailer assignment board. Door 3: T-9022, AT DOOR. For the first time today, the board is telling the truth.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The trailer assignment board. Door 3: T-9022, DEPARTED. Someone has drawn a tiny trailer driving off the edge of the board.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Ingrid, the shipping clerk. Every piece of paper in the building eventually stops at her desk to rest. She has the look of someone who has said "that's not my department" for so long it became her department.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: Someone who is technically not here.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: I believe so.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: Ah.
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: ...Is this the last decent coffee?
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: Who had it?
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: She already has coffee. She's not greedy. She just needs it.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Ingrid drinks. Something in the room relaxes by about four degrees.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: It needs a signature from Operations. That's literally the point of the form.
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: It's blank. That's a piece of paper, not a request.
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: Form 7-Q, filled, signed. Where did you find a pen? I'm genuinely impressed.
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: It says nothing is wrong yet. Scan something that is wrong and come back.
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry. Line direction: glances at the screen.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: Cushion-tire, per the plate. Propane, per the system. Tennessee, per the system. And it is standing forty feet from my desk.
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry. Line direction: squints at the scanner.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: ...Fine. That is a reason. I will note it. (She does not write anything down. She is noting it.)
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: If it creates work, no.
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Ingrid's eyes rise slowly from her work and meet yours over the top of her monitor. Hollis takes his hand off the mouse.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Ingrid's WMS terminal. A sticky note on the screen: "IF YOU TOUCH THIS I WILL KNOW". Hollis respects the sticky note.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis holds the crumpled label up to the terminal. The terminal makes a noise like a very small door closing. Nothing else happens. Yet.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: WMS TERMINAL — Status: "Reconciled". Reality: "Pending." The scanner and the terminal have never gotten along.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: There's always a cat on my paperwork. He's been there since Friday. He's a coworker now.
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Ingrid's desk. It is a stable ecosystem of manifests, bills of lading, sticky notes, and one small orange cat asleep on a stack of shipping papers.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Ingrid's terminal, the WMS (warehouse management system: the computer that claims to know where everything is). Guest access. The screen offers "TRAILERS", "ASSETS" and "DIRECTIVES (LOCKED)".
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: For once, it is.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: For once, the computer and the parking lot agree.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: There is an empty trailer at door 3 in the computer. There is not one at door 3 in real life. The computer is completely sure.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: T-4418 — INBOUND, DOOR 6, 8 loads, status: RECONCILED.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: T-4417 — INBOUND, DOOR 2, 8 loads, status: RECONCILED.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: T-9022 — OUTBOUND, DOOR 3, status: READY.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: T-9022 — OUTBOUND, DOOR 3, EMPTY, status: READY.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: T-9022 — DEPARTED 11:59, 8 loads, seal 88120.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The screen and the floor finally agree.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Nothing on the screen agrees with anything outside it.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: F-2231 — PROPANE SIT-DOWN — location: TENNESSEE.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: RT-77 — REACH TRUCK — location: REMOTE SITE.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: LOADS A3, A4 — REACH TRUCKS — dest: NEBRASKA (per Directive 7-C).
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: RT-77 — CUSHION-TIRE — location: REMOTE SITE.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: F-2231 — CUSHION-TIRE — location: HERE.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: Hint: "HALO engineering password (original)."
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: ACCESS LEVEL REQUIRED: ADMIN.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis has a vague sense he should read the records before rewriting them. That is the kind of discipline that comes with experience.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The terminal already agrees with reality. It seems to be holding its breath.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The terminal wants an ADMIN password to change asset identities. Its install hint says "HALO engineering password (original)". Hollis has none. He suspects someone who is technically not employed here does.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis has the serials from Tucker's notebook, but the system's claim about the remote site should be confirmed by someone standing next to that reach truck. Ozzie, maybe.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis logs in as admin (using a password he was not supposed to be told). He opens the identity table. RT-77 is carrying F-2231's cushion-tire spec, and F-2231 has been handed a propane spec and a Tennessee address off Directive 7-C. Tucker's notebook has the original plates and serials for both.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: Tucker's.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: I found the notebook.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: Whose?
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: ...Huh.
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry. Line direction: very long pause.

entries.speaker: INGRID
entries.text: ...Did you just fix that?
entries.direction: Efficient shipping clerk; weary, precise, paperwork-hardened, dry.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Somewhere, two pieces of equipment are handed back the personalities they had all along.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: Identities restored. F-2231: CUSHION-TIRE (HERE). RT-77: REACH TRUCK (REMOTE SITE).
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The big HALO dashboard (corporate's scoreboard for every site), showing every regional site at a serene 100%. The glow flickers oddly, as if there is more underneath. A graph shows "Cat Population" as a flat line at zero, labeled "N/A (no approved metric)".
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: It approved its own directive.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: And then it thanked itself for its service.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis has traced the chaos upward: Operations followed the system, the system followed a Regional directive, and the Regional directive followed the system. It is a circle. It is a perfectly green circle.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Below the directive, another line — the identity swap. Below THAT, a metric labeled "Cats" pointing at nothing at all.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: DIRECTIVE 7-C: "Any freight with an unassigned destination shall be assigned to the nearest site with a shortfall." ORIGIN: Regional Operations (automated template). AUTO-APPROVED BY: HALO. FIRST APPLIED: FRIDAY 4:07 AM.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: With MINT vision, the dashboard's glow peels back like a wet label. Lines of routing data run up out of it to the ceiling. Hollis follows one.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: HALO DASHBOARD — Accuracy: 100%. Physical inventory match: 0 of 16. Warehouse cats: N/A. Note: this device is not used to being asked questions.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: HALO DASHBOARD — Accuracy: 100%. Physical inventory match: 16 of 16. The dashboard reports 100% either way. Warehouse cats: N/A.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: HALVORSEN
entries.text: It's signed. Go. GO.
entries.direction: Operations manager; pressured, anxious, trying to sound managerial while barely holding it together.

entries.speaker: HALVORSEN
entries.text: It's blank. I can't approve nothing. (He considers it.) Actually I can. But I won't.
entries.direction: Operations manager; pressured, anxious, trying to sound managerial while barely holding it together.

entries.speaker: HALVORSEN
entries.text: A 7-Q? For Ingrid? ...Fine. What's the reason?
entries.direction: Operations manager; pressured, anxious, trying to sound managerial while barely holding it together.

entries.speaker: HALVORSEN
entries.text: Approved. (He signs in a hurry.) Don't tell Regional I approved a form. We're not measured on forms.
entries.direction: Operations manager; pressured, anxious, trying to sound managerial while barely holding it together.

entries.speaker: HALVORSEN
entries.text: I don't have time for that. Or for anything.
entries.direction: Operations manager; pressured, anxious, trying to sound managerial while barely holding it together.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: Hot shipment.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The Ops printer. A single sheet sits in the tray. It says FORM 7-Q: INFORMATION ACCESS REQUEST (For requests that will create work for Shipping, please submit for Approval).
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The tray is empty. It is already regretting.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The Ops printer. The tray is empty. It hums like it is already printing the next problem.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: TABITHA
entries.text: I'm not authorized to receive that, but I can note that you tried.
entries.direction: HR professional; upbeat, procedural, sincere, treats impossible events as policy questions.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Rows and rows of small parts bins labeled with codes only the Parts Department understands (and, at night, the Parts Department's ghost). One label reads "H-17 — HYDRAULIC SEALS, PALLET JACK, MISC".
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The bin is empty. The donut remains.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Bin H-17: "HYDRAULIC SEALS". Empty now, apart from a tiny fossilized donut.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Bin H-17: "HYDRAULIC SEALS". One seal remains in the bin, next to a tiny fossilized donut.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: It is locked and there is nothing in there Hollis needs.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The maintenance cage: torque wrenches, drum keys, one very brave mop. Neatly locked. Neatly.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The padlock needs the cage key. Hollis is looking at a lock designed by a person who did not anticipate Tucker.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The maintenance cage. The door is padlocked from the OUTSIDE. Tucker is on the inside, waving through the bars with the enthusiasm of a man on a parade float.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The cage is locked and nobody is in it. Hollis keeps the key. He has a feeling.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: It is already unlocked. Tucker got out the way Tucker gets out of things: eventually.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: It does not help. The cage is a cage. The lock is a lock.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: BANG. BANG. BANG. A rhythmic, cheerful sound is coming from the maintenance cage.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: TUCKER
entries.text: HI HOLLIS! I'M FINE! I JUST HAD TO LET THE CATS OUT OF THE SECURED AREA AND THEN THE DOOR LOCKED! BUT THEY'RE OUT! ALL OF THEM! (a pause) ...THEY'RE ALL IN HERE NOW ACTUALLY.
entries.direction: Eager, enthusiastic, extremely willing to help; accidentally chaotic. Line direction: muffled.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis works the padlock free. The cage door swings open. A dozen cats stream out past Tucker like commuters.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: TUCKER
entries.text: Hollis! You saved me! I'd have been in there until lunch. Or Wednesday.
entries.direction: Eager, enthusiastic, extremely willing to help; accidentally chaotic.

entries.speaker: TUCKER
entries.text: REALLY?
entries.direction: Eager, enthusiastic, extremely willing to help; accidentally chaotic. Line direction: lights up like a trailer at night.

entries.speaker: TUCKER
entries.text: Oh — wait. Here. I always write serial numbers down when I move stuff. It's a thing I do. Nobody's ever asked for it before.
entries.direction: Eager, enthusiastic, extremely willing to help; accidentally chaotic.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The hook is empty. Its sign still says "SEE TUCKER".
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Empty hook. Not empty of meaning.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A hook labeled "CAGE KEY — DO NOT LOSE". A key hangs from it. Below, a sign: "IF KEY IS MISSING SEE TUCKER." The key is not missing, which is exciting.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Rack 14. The bottom two levels are empty except for shadow. Cats keep walking into this gap, one after another, with purpose. None come out. It is a very organized disappearance.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Rack 14: behind the pallet wall, an old conveyor tunnel. The cats knew.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Juno noses along the base of the rack. A pallet that looked bolted down is just leaning. She shoulders it. Behind it: a dark opening, and a cat-shaped silhouette sitting in it like a doorman.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Juno wags at the tunnel. She thinks she invented it.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A disused conveyor tunnel, hidden behind Rack 14, still marked "CONVEYOR 9". It goes somewhere. Cats go there.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The storage slots are ready to receive freight. A sign says "STORAGE: PLEASE PUT WHERE IT BELONGS" and someone has added "(WMS: HAHA)".
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Eight slots are designated for tonight's storage. Right now ${n} of them contain the correct freight, each one scanned into the right rack location.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: RACK STORAGE — ${sortedCount('store')}/8 loads stored correctly. The scanner agrees with the rack. This is the first time this week.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Still missing:
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis stops at the door. He is not walking into a Regional Review without proof.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis can hear voices beyond the door and decides now is not the moment. He should wrap up the shift first.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: There is no dot from Bruno.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Pallet ${p.code}, wrapped and labeled. The label says one thing. The pallet looks like it might mean another.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: There are twelve cats sleeping on it. It is the warmest pallet in the building: a 48-volt battery pack, quietly radiating.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: There is a chalk dot on the corner in Bruno's handwriting.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis collects the third bowl. He feels like he has just closed a very small door on a very big problem.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The staging board now reads CLEAR. Someone has drawn a small, smug cat next to it.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A board announcing that staging is occupied by inbound freight and that outbound freight will therefore be "assigned space at a later date". It is the later date.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: Reach trucks. Marked for Nebraska. The manifest said Tennessee.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: PHYSICAL CHECK: serial data CORRUPTED. Label and freight do not correlate. Confidence: low. Try again with better vision.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: PALLET ${p.code} — LABEL: "${p.sys}".
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Nothing on the Kestrel order matches this.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Something on the Kestrel order matches this.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: PHYSICAL TRUTH — ${p.real}.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: The label and the freight have never met. ${p.dest === 'ship' ? 'It matches the Kestrel order.' : 'It is not on the Kestrel order.'}
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: PALLET ${p.code} — ${p.real}. Label: "${p.sys}". Label matches freight. ${p.dest === 'ship' ? 'On the Kestrel PO.' : 'Not on the Kestrel PO.'}
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis needs a pallet jack for this. Something that doesn't leak hydraulic fluid on his boots. Ideally Bruno's.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: I'm not asking the system.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The WMS has this pallet on "RECONCILIATION HOLD" until its records are fixed. The system will not let Hollis move it, or, more accurately, will not let the system move it, which is the same thing.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The pallet jack disagrees. The pallet jack has a chip in it.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: BRUNO
entries.text: I don't load pallets with a cat on it. Or twelve. I have a policy.
entries.direction: Competent loader; practical, grounded, low-key, mildly exasperated. Deliver as radio communication; apply radio filtering in-game rather than baking it into the master when possible.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Twelve cats are sleeping on it.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The policy is his own. It is sound.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis slides the pallet jack under ${p.code}. It groans with mechanical trust.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis brings it back to its lane, as though nothing happened. Three minutes of the morning are gone.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis starts to move it. Two seconds later the jack pulls hard to one side and a small chorus of forklift horns delivers a verdict.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Before it goes, Hollis slits the wrap and scoops some kibble into a tote lid. This pallet is not a counterweight, and the cats will need a trail.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Pallet ${p.code}: ${where === 'ship' ? 'OUTBOUND' : 'STORAGE'}. Correct. The scanner chirps a note of professional respect.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: That's sixteen.
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The last pallet leaves the lane. The staging lanes are empty. Every line is painted concrete. It is beautiful.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Eight loads to the outbound dock. Eight loads to storage. Nothing duplicated. Nothing missing. Somewhere, a spreadsheet feels seen.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The manifest is missing page 2.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Trailer T-4417, inbound from Tennessee. It is empty now — the pallets have all been moved to staging. The manifest says 8 loads.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Manifest pages: 2 of 2 (page 2 recovered from a cat).
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Manifest pages: 1 of 2. Page 2: NOT FOUND. Cat: FOUND.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Both pages are accounted for now. One has a paw print.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: T-4417 — 8 loads inbound (Tennessee).
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: T-4418 — 8 loads inbound. Manifest pages: 2 of 2. Match: partial. Confidence: "meh".
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Dock door 9, shut for the first time in weeks. The seal is torn but the door works.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: A cat is sitting in the doorway, not moving. Closing it would be theft of a cat's front door. It may be best to solve the actual problem first.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis rolls door 9 shut. It closes with a satisfying WHUMP. The last of the outside comes to an end.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: It is shut. It is done.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Dock door 9, ROLLED UP since who-knows-when. The seal is torn. There is a line of paw prints leading in from the yard and a second line, much smaller, leading in behind them.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis yanks the plug. The printer exhales one last label and dies. Four hundred labels cover the floor like confetti at a very boring parade.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The inbound label printer. It has a small screen showing "TEMPLATES: 000 (TEST), 001 (RECEIVING), 002 (OUTBOUND)...". Template 000 is marked "ADMIN — GROUND TRUTH REFERENCE — DO NOT USE".
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The plug is already out.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: LABEL PRINTER — TEMPLATE 000: "GROUND TRUTH REFERENCE (ADMIN, HALO INSTALL TECH USE ONLY)". Last printed: 1 label. By: TUCKER. "Test".
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: HOLLIS
entries.text: What's the bad news?
entries.direction: Dry, tired, restrained; understated warehouse lead. Rarely matches the absurdity around him.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Labels are landing everywhere. Each says "TEST TEST TEST" and, in tiny print, "T."
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: TUCKER
entries.text: HOLLIS! GOOD NEWS AND BAD NEWS! The label printer is printing labels!
entries.direction: Eager, enthusiastic, extremely willing to help; accidentally chaotic.

entries.speaker: TUCKER
entries.text: It won't stop! (beat) Also I've been standing here for eleven minutes.
entries.direction: Eager, enthusiastic, extremely willing to help; accidentally chaotic.

entries.speaker: TORVALD
entries.text: No.
entries.direction: Large, laconic, bored, low-energy confidence; says little unless necessary. Line direction: taking it, turning it over, handing it back.

entries.speaker: SYSTEM
entries.text: a warm, tall, cigarette-shaped heat signature resolves into Torvald, who is standing exactly where he was standing.
entries.direction: Neutral corporate system voice; precise, impersonal.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Juno has already found Torvald this round. She looks smug about it.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Juno sniffs around, but doesn't know who Hollis wants. She needs a scent: something Torvald wore or touched.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Juno freezes, points her nose at a spot that looks entirely like nothing, and barks twice.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: TORVALD
entries.text: ...Aw, c'mon.
entries.direction: Large, laconic, bored, low-energy confidence; says little unless necessary. Line direction: from behind an object.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Juno sniffs, lifts her head, and looks pointedly toward ${dir}. She has the scent. It is not here.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: BRUNO
entries.text: Not a loader thing. What do you need?
entries.direction: Competent loader; practical, grounded, low-key, mildly exasperated.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: All eight boxes are ticked.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The load plan. "KESTREL — DOOR 3 — TRAILER T-9022 — 8 LOADS." Bruno has drawn eight little boxes and, next to each, a small colored dot. Two colors: orange and blue.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: All eight boxes are ticked. Next to them: "11:59".
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Door 3 is empty. The computer says T-9022 is here. The computer has said that since Friday.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Door 3 is empty again. T-9022 pulled out at 11:59, sealed 88120, eight loads aboard. The dock plate is up. The light is red, which is correct.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Door 3. T-9022 is finally in it, doors open, dock plate down, and the light is green. It is a pretty sight.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The trailer is seated. Pushing it would be a strange way to celebrate.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The dock door is up. It does not need to be pushed. It needs a trailer.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: DOOR 3 — TRAILER: T-9022 (per WMS). PHYSICAL: EMPTY. Search radius 0.5 miles: NOT FOUND.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: DOOR 3 — EMPTY. Last trailer: T-9022, DEPARTED 11:59, seal 88120. Confidence: high.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: SCANNER
entries.text: DOOR 3 — T-9022 SEATED. Seal: available. Confidence: high.
entries.direction: Dry handheld-device system voice; crisp, synthetic, mildly judgmental.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The outbound queue, at Door 3. ${sortedCount('ship')} of 8 Kestrel loads are lined up and waiting for a trailer to land.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: TORVALD
entries.text: My smoke log. Friday, 4:07 AM, inbound kiosk: HALO printed a directive, approved it, and thanked itself. Nobody there but me and a cat. If anyone asks, I was on break.
entries.direction: Large, laconic, bored, low-energy confidence; says little unless necessary.

entries.speaker: TORVALD
entries.text: I'm standing here. It's dock 3. I'm holding a radio. I'm being a spotter. Don't make it weird.
entries.direction: Large, laconic, bored, low-energy confidence; says little unless necessary.

entries.speaker: TORVALD
entries.text: Before I go stand somewhere useful. Here.
entries.direction: Large, laconic, bored, low-energy confidence; says little unless necessary.

entries.speaker: TUCKER
entries.text: I'm holding the door. I'm doing it. I'm not moving. (a long pause) Is it working?
entries.direction: Eager, enthusiastic, extremely willing to help; accidentally chaotic.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The trail is laid. Any more and it becomes a buffet.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis lays a thin line of kibble along the outbound apron toward the yard. It smells like a suggestion.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: The jack is fixed. It hisses only in contentment.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Hollis holds up the hydraulic seal kit. Bruno's eyes go wide, then narrow, then wide.
entries.direction: Deadpan omniscient narrator; dry, observant, never sells the joke too hard.

entries.speaker: BRUNO
entries.text: Is that an H-17? Where did you find that? I've been asking Parts for that seal since March. (He stops.) Nobody's in Parts. (He starts again.) Who let you into Parts?
entries.direction: Competent loader; practical, grounded, low-key, mildly exasperated.

entries.speaker: BRUNO
entries.text: Don't tell me. Actually, do tell me.
entries.direction: Competent loader; practical, grounded, low-key, mildly exasperated.

entries.speaker: NARRATOR
entries.text: Bruno drops to a knee and works the seal into the jack. It fizzes, then hums. The jack rises. It lowers. It rises again. The puddle stops.
